name: Pramipexole
summary: Pramipexole, sold under the brand Mirapex among others, is a medication used to treat Parkinson's disease and restless legs syndrome. In Parkinson's disease it may be used alone or together with levodopa. It is taken by mouth. Pramipexole is a dopamine agonist of the non-ergoline class.

combinations.note: Listed as a significant drug interaction on Wikidata.

pharmacology.text: Pramipexole is a dopamine agonist of the non-ergoline class.
pharmacology.kind: Dopamine receptor agonist; Dopamine D2-like receptor agonist; Antiparkinsonian agent

uses.text: Pramipexole is used in the treatment of Parkinson's disease and restless legs syndrome. Safety in pregnancy and breastfeeding is unknown. A 2008 meta-analysis found that pramipexole was more effective than ropinirole in the treatment of restless legs syndrome.

summaryZh: 普拉克索，是一種用於治療帕金森氏症與不寧腿症候群的藥物。 在巴金森氏症中，可單獨使用或與左旋多巴併用。 本藥由口服給藥。 普拉克索屬於非麥角靈的多巴胺致效劑。

sideEffects.en: Common effects include nausea, sleepiness, dizziness, low blood pressure on standing and swollen ankles. It can cause sudden sleep attacks, hallucinations and impulse control problems such as compulsive gambling, shopping, eating or sexual behaviour. Stopping suddenly can cause withdrawal symptoms.
sideEffects.zh: 常見副作用包括噁心、嗜睡、頭暈、起身時血壓偏低和腳踝水腫。它可能引起突然入睡、幻覺，以及強迫性賭博、購物、暴食或性行為等衝動控制問題。突然停藥可能出現戒斷症狀。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见副作用包括恶心、嗜睡、头晕、起身时血压偏低和脚踝水肿。它可能引起突然入睡、幻觉，以及强迫性赌博、购物、暴食或性行为等冲动控制问题。突然停药可能出现戒断症状。

fact.en: Pramipexole was developed by Boehringer Ingelheim and approved in the United States in 1997. It was later found to trigger compulsive gambling, shopping or eating in some patients, a link that changed how doctors watch for side effects of dopamine drugs.
fact.zh: 普拉克索由百靈佳殷格翰開發，1997 年在美國核准上市。後來發現它會讓部分病人出現強迫性賭博、購物或暴食，這項發現改變了醫師留意多巴胺類藥物副作用的方式。
fact.zhHans: 普拉克索由百灵佳殷格翰开发，1997 年在美国核准上市。后来发现它会让部分病人出现强迫性赌博、购物或暴食，这项发现改变了医师留意多巴胺类药物副作用的方式。
